look.concierge: The Concierge's face, as big as weather, watching the street with kind attention.
look.raw: The moon. You'd forgotten it was still up there.

hotspots.name: Shop sign
hotspots.look: RADIO REPAIR, in gold leaf. Somebody still cares about lettering.

hotspots.name: Monitor
hotspots.look: A green line rising and falling, like something breathing on the other end.

hotspots.name: Notice
hotspots.look: A handwritten notice on the lamp post. MISSING, and a name the rain has taken.

look.concierge: People strolling under glowing umbrellas. Nobody hurries here.
look.raw: One figure on the walkway, standing still in the rain. The rest of the crowd was never there.

look.concierge: Three clipped topiaries and a polite sign: Please rest.
look.raw: A man asleep on the bench under a wet blanket. Nobody has woken him in a while.

look.concierge: A woman in a red dress, dining at the machine. She smiles at nothing in particular.
look.raw: She's wire-thin, her wrist locked in the cradle, head down. The red dress was never there.

hotspots.name: Bar sign
hotspots.look: A red neon pin-up over a door. Human-made, unlicensed. The Concierge disapproves, politely.

hotspots.name: Bakery
hotspots.look: Real bread behind the glass. A week of credits a loaf, and someone still bakes it.
